title: feat(spec): translate a settings map specifier's column headers
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiR1iqus8kMX7vh9PVAPJir9)_

Fixes #31453

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：平台设置翻译包里，每个设置项可以翻译 map 表格的表头了：`keyColumn`（键列）和 `columns.列名`（各值列），各含 `label`（表头）与 `help`（悬停说明）。数据生命周期三张表的 5 个表头已写进 10 个非英文语言包，控制台表格读取这些翻译。
- **为什么改**：用中文等非英文界面打开「数据生命周期」时，保留期覆盖、行数配额、按类别默认配额三张表的表头一直是英文，翻译包里没有地方能放它们。
- **风险与回滚**：只放宽平台翻译包的解析（两个新的可选键，形状严格），存储、保存校验和 manifest 都不变；应用自带的翻译包仍然整组拒绝 `settings`。直接 revert 即可回滚。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`（`keys` 条目新增 `keyColumn` / `columns` 与 `settingsMapColumnTranslation`）；`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsMapField.tsx`（表头读翻译）；`packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`（表头纳入逐语言覆盖校验）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.mapRows-31391.test.tsx -t 31453`，预期 2 条通过：中文下表头显示「对象 / 行保留时长」，没翻译的列保留英文。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Spec** (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`). The platform bundle's `settings.NAMESPACE.keys.KEY` entry gains two optional groups, spelled as the `map` specifier spells its headers:
  - `keyColumn`: the key column, `{ label, help }`;
  - `columns`: a record keyed by the column `name`, each `{ label, help }`.
  `label` translates the specifier column's `label`; `help` translates its `description`, the spelling the setting entry already uses for a specifier's `description`. Both are built with the same `strictObject({ surface, history: TRANSLATION_HISTORY, aliases })` helper as their siblings. On the setting entry, `keyHeader` is answered `keyColumn` and `headers` / `columnLabels` are answered `columns`. On a column, `title` / `header` / `heading` are answered `label`, `description` / `helpText` / `hint` are answered `help`, and a specifier column pasted in whole gets a prescription for `name` (it is the record key, `columns.NAME`) and `kind` (not translatable), never a rename. A bundle written before this change parses unchanged. `ServedTranslationDataSchema` spreads the same shape, so the served document carries the groups with no other change. `SpecifierSchema`'s `keyColumn` / `columns` TSDoc names the translation address, as `confirmOffText` does.
- **Bundles** (`@objectstack/service-settings`). zh-CN, zh-Hant, ja-JP, ko, es-ES, pt-BR, fr, de, ru and ar translate the five headers of `lifecycle.retention_overrides`, `lifecycle.quotas` and `lifecycle.quota_defaults` (`Object`, `Keep rows for`, `Expire rows after`, `Max rows`, `Lifecycle class`). The coverage test holds every `map` header to the same per-locale coverage as the setting's label, and refuses header copy on a setting that is not a map or for a column the map does not declare.
- **Console overlay** (cross-lane `ui/` files, named in the claim's file surface). `keys.KEY.label` is overlaid in the console, by `useSettingsLabel`, not on the server; the new leaves are read there too: `mapKeyColumnLabel` / `mapKeyColumnHelp` / `mapColumnLabel` / `mapColumnHelp`, handed to `SettingsMapField` as `headerText`. A miss keeps the manifest's text in the page language (`pickLocalized`), as every other settings string does. `help` is the header's hover text; the key column now shows its declared `description` there too, as the value columns already did, so both declared leaves are read.

Served Data Lifecycle page in zh-CN, `retention_overrides` headers (measured by the new console test against the shipped zh-CN strings):

| | key column | `maxAge` | `expireAfter` |
|---|---|---|---|
| before | Object | Keep rows for | Expire rows after |
| after | 对象 | 行保留时长 | 行过期时长 |

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/system/translation.test.ts`, `a map setting's column headers`: the leaves parse on the platform face, the platform bundle and the served document; the four entry-level aliases name their targets; an undeclared leaf on a column and on the key column is refused at its path with the alias named; a bare string is refused as `invalid_type` at its path; a pasted specifier column gets the `columns.NAME` prescription and no `name` rename.
- `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`: both new directions. Mutation check: renaming zh-CN's `expireAfter` entry to `expireAt` reds both `missing for lifecycle: key:retention_overrides.columns.expireAfter` and `undeclared settings copy: lifecycle.key:retention_overrides.columns.expireAt`.
- `SettingsView.mapRows-31391.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe` in the existing harness: zh-CN headers and hover text through the real `SettingsView` render path, an untranslated column keeps its literal, the translated header still names the row's cells and key picker, and a one-column map reads its own key. Reverse check: with `headerText` unwired, both cases red (`[ 'Object', 'Keep rows for', … ]`).

## Acceptance notes

- **Shape vs the order.** The order proposed `keyColumn` as a plain string because the specifier's key column "carries only `label`". Measured: `SpecifierMapKeyColumnSchema` declares `label` and `description`, and `SpecifierMapColumnSchema` declares `label`, `description`, `kind` and `name`. `description` is user-visible text (the value columns render it as the header's `title`). So both groups are `{ label, help }` objects, which also leaves no string-to-object change owed later.
- **Changeset level.** `Metadata-protocol: none` grades every entry `patch` (`scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`), so `@objectstack/spec` is `patch`, not the `minor` the order suggested. `none` holds because `settings` is platform-only: both application doors refuse it by name, and `authorable-surface/` does not move.
- **ui exhaustive copies.** This is a nested leaf under `settings`, not a new top-level group. `SpecTranslationData` in `@object-ui/i18n` forwards `settings` opaquely, and nothing in `ui/` enumerates settings-key leaves except `useSettingsLabel`, which this PR extends. `@object-ui/console` type-check is green.
- **Not added.** No `resolveSettings*` helper in `i18n-resolver.ts`: that family has no in-repo caller for settings keys, and the `confirmOffText` precedent added none.
- **Serial.** #31451 (draws these tables) is merged. No open PR on these files was found.
- **Review.** An independent review of the spec diff and the code implementing it: round 1 PASS with should-fix (the `name` alias, a detached TSDoc block, one loose test assertion, wording in four locales), all fixed; delta re-review PASS.

## Verification

<details><summary>dispatch-gates: 97 derived, 97 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED</summary>

All 97 derived commands exit 0 on this head's tree after `git merge origin/main`. Nine first exited 3 (prerequisite: a stale spec `dist/`, unbuilt packages, the teardown fixture commit missing from the shallow clone) and exit 0 after `turbo run build --filter=./packages/**` and fetching the fixture commit. `check:test-typecheck` needs a larger heap locally (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=12288`); the debt file was not regenerated. Also: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exit 0, `check:doc-authoring` exit 0, eslint on every touched file exit 0, `@object-ui/console` type-check exit 0, spec `translation.test.ts` + `src/shared` 1224 pass, service-settings translations 135 pass, console map/label suites 22 pass.
